question: Who is the author of the book ‘Gone Girl’?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Gillian Flynn**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **American author Gillian Flynn **published the suspenseful murder thriller **Gone Girl in 2012.**
 
• In June 2012,** Crown Publishing Group **released it.
 
• The book was well-liked and was listed among the** New York Times Best Sellers.**
 
• The suspense and mystery books **Sharp Objects (2006) and Dark Places **are among Gillian Flynn's best-known works.
